title: [RC1] SMB/Close Loop stops after Calibrations
symptom: Every time the user calibrates using DexcomApp, and the values are very similar, AndroidAPS detects as two readings close to each other and stops the SMB/Close Loop. The user has to manually remove the reading in red.
cause: The issue is likely related to the BG value adjusted after calibration, and it appears to be a bug in the Dexcom app where calibration is sent as a BG value too.
fix: Fixed by commit 0603e741be6c6cd23d2d4b6c84c70de528b63a43 for G5 BYODA. No way to fix it in xDrip on AAPS side.
